{{Quote|See this? Looks like some kind of gem.''"<br />"''You're right. An amethyst, I think.''"<br />"''I'll take your word for it.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Survivor">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Amethyst''' was a [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]].<ref name="Queen">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref> The [[activation stud]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lorana Jinzler]]'s [[Lorana Jinzler's lightsaber|lightsaber]] contained an amethyst that was gifted to her by a group of people living in the mid levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that she and her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Jorus C'baoth]], had aided. Unbeknown to Jinzler, the gemstone was in fact a gift from her [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's mother|mother]] and [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's father|father]]. Her [[Parent/Legends|parents]], who revered the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and loved their [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], knew the people that she had helped and asked them to give it to her. The amethyst was one of the reasons her younger brother [[Dean Jinzler]] resented his sister, frustrated that she did not realize it was a gift from her parents despite her [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
